{{Top|leg}}
The '''cloaca''' was a bodily orifice that existed on some [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals. The [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] was one such species known to possess a cloaca. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] also possessed a cloaca flap.<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
